Tsukiji outer market is one of Tokyo's most famous seafood destinations. Visitors can enjoy fresh sushi and seafood dishes.

Shinjuku is one of tokyo's most popular nightlife districts, offering bars, restaurnats ad entertainement venues.
senso-ji temple is a historic buddhist temple located in Asakusa and is one of Tokyo's most visited cultural attractions.
